llm_response.reason: The website mimics Birkenstock, a well-known brand, but uses a domain name unrelated to the official company and registered very recently (June 2025). The certificate is new and short-lived, matching common fraud patterns. There is no evidence of a legitimate company behind the site. These factors, combined with standard fake shop tactics like security reassurance and free shipping, strongly indicate this is a scam site attempting to deceive buyers.
